Madrat Mule

Source: R/madrat_mule.R
madrat_mule.Rd

Convert anything to a magpie object and back to traffic data across madrat borders.

Usage

madrat_mule(x)

Arguments

x

Anything.

Value

A magpie object containing x (in unusable form), or the original x if a magpie object was passed.

Author

Michaja Pehl

Examples

str(x <- madrat_mule(quitte_example_data))
#> A magpie object (package: magclass)
#>  @ .Data:  int [1:614147] 88 10 0 0 0 3 0 4 5 3 ...
#>  $ dimnames:List of 3
#>   ..$ fake: chr "GLO"
#>   ..$ NA  : NULL
#>   ..$ NA  : NULL
madrat_mule(x)
